description: A gauge arc showing an air quality reading of 38 with a label in the middle.
overview: A `RadialBarChart` drawn from 210 to -30 degrees, with a single value on a 0 to 100 `PolarAngleAxis` and a tinted track behind it. The number and its rating are `Text` layered over the arc. Nothing is interactive.
usage: Change the `value` in `chartData` (0 to 100) and the centered text to match it; the label and color live in `chartConfig`. The component takes no props.
